description: Source code for device descriptor management, including initialization, cleanup, retrieval, and validation functions, with parsing logic for device descriptor files.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsInit
methods.description: Initializes the device descriptors module with specified whitelist and blacklist paths.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up allocated resources for device descriptors.

methods.name: deviceDescriptorsGet
methods.description: Retrieves a device descriptor matching the specified manufacturer, model, hardware, and firmware versions.

methods.name: parseFiles
methods.description: Parses device descriptor files based on the whitelist and blacklist paths.

methods.name: versionInRange
methods.description: Checks if a given version string is within the allowed versions list or range.

methods.name: getWhiteListPath
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current whitelist path.

methods.name: getBlackListPath
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current blacklist path.

methods.name: checkWhiteListValid
methods.description: Validates if a whitelist file is parsable and contains valid device descriptors.

methods.name: checkBlackListValid
methods.description: Validates if a blacklist file is parsable and contains valid UUIDs.
